description: This file contains utility classes and functions for Snowflake integration within a larger language model framework, including exception handling, parameter mapping, API base URL construction, environment validation, and provider info retrieval.

classes.name: SnowflakeException
classes.description: Exception class for handling Snowflake AI endpoint errors, inherits from BaseLLMException.

classes.name: SnowflakeBaseConfig
classes.description: Configuration class providing methods for supported parameters, API URL construction, environment validation, and provider info for Snowflake integration.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-like parameters for a given model.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters into optional parameters if they are supported for the specified model.

methods.name: _get_api_base
methods.description: Constructs and returns the API base URL, appending '/api/v2' if necessary.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares and returns headers for Snowflake API requests, validating presence of API key and setting authorization headers.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Retrieves provider info, including API base URL and API key, with fallback to secret store.
